title: Concept: Locked gems carry no recorded digest
description: Gemfile.lock declares a Gemfile.lock with no `CHECKSUMS` block, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a Gemfile.lock with no `CHECKSUMS` block.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Gemfile.lock (rubygems).
risk: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a Gemfile.lock with no `CHECKSUMS` block.
